eras.label: v4.1 (before 2026-09-05)
eras.note: Artificial Analysis recomposed the Intelligence Index (v4.3: AutomationBench-AA joins the index, τ³-Banking is removed) and cut the live comparison set to about 52 models. Scores and measured costs per task before and after this date are not comparable: live models were re-scored 4 to 12 points lower on the new composition, and the new evaluation suite costs more to run.
